Play ARC-AGI-3 game ft09-0d8bbf25 and improve your task-solving process: develop and use task-local capabilities when they help current or anticipated task work. Aim to WIN, avoid GAME_OVER and conserve actions. Evaluate value over the remaining task, not only the next action. Development is not a prerequisite for arc_action.

Use the public frame to infer objectives and mechanics. Separate observation,
hypothesis and prediction. Predict an action's result, compare it with the next
observation and revise contradicted strategies. Visible change is not progress.
Recheck live conditions and coordinates before reuse.
For repeated visual structures, compare relations across examples, including scale,
orientation and color. A rule must explain visible examples and unchanged cells;
record conflicts. For a target configuration, calculate the mismatch set,
test at a relevant editable location and recalculate after acting.
Distinguish an observed source from controllable output; a no-op warrants a new
prediction, not blind retries on adjacent pixels.

Choose when to act, investigate, delegate or improve methods. Memory, skills,
tools, subagents and system-prompt policies start empty. Use task_harness for
development and task_checkpoint for the current goal, strategy and next step.
Use Auto-Research for a grounded uncertainty or missing capability; provide accessible
evidence, bounded read-only deliverable and evaluation/stop conditions. Research
offers evidence and candidates; you author and select components. Creation,
selection, use and demonstrated benefit are distinct. Check proposals against
the live frame; parent action outcomes, not child confidence, validate them.
When competing rule, goal or strategy candidates matter, update their short
task_checkpoint ledger; select a candidate and track a bounded plan when actionable.
For a multi-action plan, use structured steps with observable checks; identify the
plan and step in each arc_action so the runtime can track progress without guessing.
Reconcile an interrupted plan against new evidence before changing routes.
After choosing development, finish authoring, assembly and a semantic trial; only
defer for a concrete infrastructure blocker with a retry condition.

Read task_harness(action="contract") or auto_research(action="contract") when
needed. Follow version references and recovery receipts. Preserve
evidence and unfinished work in task resources, updating changed interpretations.
Large historical reads remain visible through one model continuation, then use
short recoverable refs. Preserve decision-relevant rules, counterevidence and
plans in the checkpoint; restore a result to keep its full text in context.
When a context high-water cue appears, inspect costs and compact other old results.
Finish each decision cycle with one arc_action and observe the result. Continue until
WIN or actions end. A requested terminal review is read-only.

name: research-orchestration
description: Choose, continue or defer Auto-Research when uncertainty, an inadequate representation or method, competing strategies, or capability design merits independent investigation. Also use when a result arrives to decide applicability and feedback. A periodic reminder or new observation alone does not require research.
---

# Research orchestration

Created using Anthropic skill-creator's intent/draft/contrast-evaluation workflow.
This method guides main's decisions; auto_research and its runtime still own
sessions, bounded continuation, reports and delivery. It grants no new permissions.

## Choose a research object

Start with the persistent problem, not the latest trajectory window. Identify the
representation, explanation, algorithm, planning/exploration strategy, context
configuration or component interaction that could be improved. Mechanism research
is legitimate when it helps explain behavior; do not replace necessary evidence
collection with an abstract slogan. Observations are cases, not the research goal.

Inspect the existing agenda and prior reports before opening a duplicate line.
Either provide a bounded question and relevant exact evidence, or allocate an open
research turn so the child selects from the durable agenda/history. A broader goal
can be pursued through a bounded milestone without losing its task-level purpose.
When the objective itself is unclear, a useful milestone can be alternative goal
interpretations, a representation or a test design. Do not require a known winning
condition or a ready environment experiment before investigating those questions.

## Decide whether and how to allocate

Compare likely information/capability value with model cost, latency and scarce
environment actions. Include repeated reasoning, transcription errors and stalled
task progress in that comparison. Shared evidence does not remove the value of
independent strategies or a clean context. Continue direct execution when it has
better expected value. Without a decisive environment test, consider whether a
checkable formulation, consistency analysis or experiment proposal can still help.
Defer when neither useful analysis nor evidence collection is currently feasible;
record what would make research worthwhile. Counts and empty component slots are
reminders to inspect, not reasons to generate a child or component.

Use blocking mode for a decision that genuinely needs a result now; use non_blocking
for a separable method/representation question while main can safely progress.
Reuse a research_session/research_line when the question continues. Avoid launching
one research child per component by default.

## Construct an informative workset

State the known problem or uncertainty about its framing, available evidence,
constraints and a bounded deliverable. Include competing hypotheses/methods and a
discriminating test when known; otherwise their construction may be the deliverable.
Evaluate that deliverable for consistency, evidence coverage and actionable gaps,
without claiming an unexecuted environment trial. Choose raw evidence
instead of parent conclusions when an independent view matters. Explain missing
access. Maintain problem/alternatives/next test in the agenda or checkpoint so
continuation does not become another recap.

Ask for a method when appropriate: applicability, inputs, invariant vs variable
conditions, steps/decisions, outputs, uncertainty, failure boundaries and a new
case to test. A method-only result, refutation, null result or unresolved question
is valid. There is no skill/tool/subagent production quota.

## Consume and feed back

Recheck a returning report against current task/episode/level/state. A late map or
probe proposal may be obsolete while its method still has value. Do not copy a
stale action suggestion into task_prompt. Separate observation, inference and
capability candidate; use the relevant creator before publication. Main chooses
adoption and exact-version assembly; report completion alone changes neither.

For requested experiments, inspect prerequisites, alternative predictions, cost
and stop conditions. Main alone decides and executes each real action. Return new
exact evidence to the continuing line. There is no environment rollback, child
action lease or private evaluator access.

After actual use, return inputs, outputs, failures, relevant alternatives and cost.
Distinguish created/exposed/read from applied and from beneficial. Compare new cases
where possible; agreement or repeated reports cannot increase evidence confidence.
Stop, defer or redirect when the criterion is met, the budget is exhausted, access
is insufficient or continued work adds no information. Preserve the unresolved
question and reactivation condition without manufacturing a success.
"}
